test_cases.name: Default single Markdown record with a fixed seed
test_cases.expected: Markdown table with header 字段|内容 and rows 记录编号/打卡日期/打卡类型/打卡时间/打卡地点/打卡方式/打卡状态/备注

test_cases.name: Plain-text record output
test_cases.expected: Plain-text record, one line per field

test_cases.name: Reproducible output for the same seed
test_cases.expected: Identical JSON for repeated runs with the same seed

notes: Pure local Python 3 skill: no Huawei Cloud credentials, CLI, SDK, or network access. All cases are read-only and only read the built-in data pool. The smoke harness only executes hcloud/curl commands, so these script cases are reported as not-executed; the structural self-check plus the unit tests under tests/ cover the behaviour.
